description: Standardized parametrization library for experimental devices, supports, fixtures, and instrumentation components used in the Concrete Grand Challenge Experimental Database.

common_parameters.name: x_location_mm
common_parameters.description: x-coordinate of the device or support location in the specimen geometry coordinate system.

common_parameters.name: y_location_mm
common_parameters.description: y-coordinate of the device or support location in the specimen geometry coordinate system.

common_parameters.name: z_location_mm
common_parameters.description: z-coordinate of the device or support location in the specimen geometry coordinate system.

common_parameters.name: orientation
common_parameters.description: Orientation of the device or support relative to the specimen geometry coordinate system.

entries.description: Parametrized deformable pad support used to model compliant boundary conditions in experimental setups.

coordinate_system.description: All coordinates and dimensions are defined within the right-handed Cartesian coordinate system associated with the specimen geometry.

parameters.name: depth
parameters.description: Pad dimension measured along the axis defined by the orientation parameter and orthogonal to the contact surface.

parameters.name: thickness
parameters.description: Pad thickness measured in-plane to the contact surface.

parameters.name: length
parameters.description: Pad dimension measured in-plane to the contact surface.

parameters.name: elastic_modulus
parameters.description: Elastic modulus of the pad material.

parameters.name: yielding_stress
parameters.description: Yield stress of the pad material.

parameters.name: stress_vs_strain_curve
parameters.description: Embedded constitutive stress-strain response of the pad material.
